description: Screen any wallet address for compliance and security risk in one call: sanctions/OFAC exposure, money-laundering, financial-crime, phishing, stealing/honeypot-related, darkweb, mixer and blacklist flags — fused into a CLEAR / CAUTION / HIGH_RISK verdict. Live from GoPlus address security across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche. $0.09/call, no API key, USDC over x402.
name: get_crypto_address_risk
